findings.issue: Fixed-camera wording can imply a locked-off shot.
findings.clarification: Preserve the source camera movement and action; do not freeze existing movement. PILOT_PACKAGE and the actual prompt already make this correct.
Text-only, still-only and video-access responses are different evidence; a path is not proof of viewing.

findings.issue: Evaluate first written plans for actionability and CFA operator effort.
findings.clarification: Do not conflate a strong written plan with measured rendering ability or camera expertise.
Specific camera treatment stays provisional until intended beat, emphasis and choreography are identified.
